title: ABS ( -3 ) is 3

source.quote: The absolute value of a number with the same data type and without its sign.
source.supports: DAX Guide: the type follows the argument

source.quote: The absolute value of a number is a decimal number, whole or decimal, without its sign.
source.supports: Microsoft Learn: the return value is a decimal number

notes: The type is not asserted: DAX Guide says the result keeps the argument type (an integer here), Microsoft Learn says the return value is a decimal number.
